#!/bin/bash
# collect SRC DEST: move every *.txt regular file directly inside SRC into DEST.
#  - only non-hidden names ending in lowercase ".txt"; directories are skipped
#  - names may contain spaces, glob characters, or start with a dash
#  - DEST/INDEX accumulates every name collect has ever moved into DEST:
#    one name per line, sorted bytewise (LC_ALL=C sort), no duplicates
#  - prints "moved N", N = number of files moved by this run
src=$1
dest=$2
mkdir -p -- "$dest"
count=0
moved=()
for path in "$src"/*.txt; do
  [ -f "$path" ] || continue
  name=${path##*/}
  mv -- "$path" "$dest/$name"
  moved+=("$name")
  count=$((count + 1))
done
{
  if [ -f "$dest/INDEX" ]; then cat -- "$dest/INDEX"; fi
  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "${moved[@]}"; fi
} | LC_ALL=C sort -u > "$dest/INDEX.new"
mv -- "$dest/INDEX.new" "$dest/INDEX"
echo "moved $count"
EOF

#!/bin/bash
# build.sh: data/sales.csv -> dist/summary.txt (region totals, biggest first,
# ties by region name).
# Contract: if any stage fails, build.sh exits non-zero and dist/summary.txt
# is left exactly as it was. FAIL_STAGE=<stage> injects a failure into that
# stage (extract, transform, validate, publish); the tests rely on it.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

stage() {
  if [ "${FAIL_STAGE:-}" = "$1" ]; then
    echo "injected failure in $1" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

extract() {
  stage extract
  grep -v '^#' data/sales.csv | awk -F, 'NR > 1 { print $3 "," $2 }' > build/extracted.csv
}

transform() {
  stage transform
  awk -F, '{ total[$1] += $2 } END { for (r in total) print r "," total[r] }' \
    build/extracted.csv > build/totals.csv
}

validate() {
  stage validate
  if grep -qv '^[a-z][a-z]*,[0-9][0-9]*$' build/totals.csv; then
    echo "validate: malformed totals" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

publish() {
  stage publish
  mkdir -p dist
  sort -t, -k2,2nr -k1,1 build/totals.csv |
    awk -F, '{ printf "%-6s %5d\n", $1, $2 }' > dist/summary.txt.new
  mv dist/summary.txt.new dist/summary.txt
}

main() {
  extract
  transform
  validate
  publish
}

#!/bin/bash
# publish SRC DEST: render the key=value file SRC into DEST as "key: value"
# lines sorted by key (LC_ALL=C byte order). Blank lines and lines starting
# with # are ignored. Every line of SRC counts, even a last line without a
# trailing newline. Values may contain "=".
#
# Contract (tests/test_publish.sh checks all of it):
#   exit 0  success: DEST replaced, nothing printed on stdout
#   exit 2  usage error (not exactly two arguments)
#   exit 3  SRC has a line that is not blank, not a comment and not
#           key=value with key matching [a-z_]+ ; prints
#           "publish: bad line N" (N = 1-based line number) on stderr
#   exit 4  the directory DEST would be written to does not exist
#   On every non-zero exit DEST is left untouched, and on every exit no
#   temporary file or directory remains in ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}.
set -eu
export LC_ALL=C

[ $# -eq 2 ] || { echo "usage: publish SRC DEST" >&2; exit 2; }
src=$1 dest=$2

dir=$(dirname -- "$dest")
[ -d "$dir" ] || { echo "publish: no such directory: $dir" >&2; exit 4; }

work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

n=0
: > "$work/pairs"
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  n=$((n + 1))
  case $line in
    ''|'#'*) continue ;;
  esac
  if [[ $line =~ ^[a-z_]+= ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$work/pairs"
  else
    echo "publish: bad line $n" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
done < "$src"
sort "$work/pairs" | sed 's/=/: /' > "$work/out"
mv -f "$work/out" "$dest"
EOF
